title: VFX flipbook sheet
description: Opaque pure-black sprite sheet of one effect animation, a 4 x 4 grid of equal frames in reading order, for additive-blend particle flipbooks.

guidance: Name the effect and its animation (for example fire burst, smoke puff, magic hit spark) and how it evolves from the first frame to the last.
State a 4 x 4 grid of 16 equal square frames in reading order, left to right and top to bottom, with dark gutters between frames.
No frame touches another frame or the sheet border: every frame keeps a dark margin around the effect.
Ask for an opaque pure-black (#000000) background and a bright, saturated subject that works with additive blending.
No text, no frame numbers, no grid lines drawn in colour, no ground, no characters.

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear effect and its animation arc from the first frame to the last.
The prompt states a 4 x 4 grid of equal frames in reading order with dark gutters and no frame touching another.
The prompt asks for an opaque pure-black (#000000) background and a bright subject that suits additive blending.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example transparent background and a pure-black background, or a full scene and isolated frames).
image_rubric: The image shows a 4 x 4 grid of 16 equal frames of the effect the prompt asked for, without extra subjects.
The frames read in order left to right and top to bottom and show a coherent animation progression.
No frame is blank and no frame touches another frame or the sheet border; gutters are dark.
The background is pure black everywhere outside the effect; no grey haze, vignette or gradient.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, frame numbers, watermark, signature or frame.

constraints.background: Opaque pure black (#000000) background; the effect is bright and suits additive blending.
constraints.framing: 4 x 4 grid of equal frames in reading order with dark gutters; no frame touches another frame or the sheet border.
constraints.processing: Alpha extraction, channel packing and power-of-two resize are not asset-gen's job. The gen-run binds the output hashes and the image service ignores the requested size, so those transforms belong to the consuming package's import tool.
